name_input: IGAKU NEEDLES PRIVATE LIMITED; IGAKU NEEDLES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/igaku-needles-private-limited) — counter states "Total Shipments 398 Records detected", "Trading Partners 7", "Ports 9", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows. Exact export line quoted: "2026-02-05 | IGAKU NEEDLES PRIVATE LIMITED | SAUDI MAIS CO.FOR MEDICAL PRODUCTS | STAINLESS STEEL NEEDLES 27G IV BC ( 0.40X 46.00 MM. ) LOT NO. 2746/0251218 ... | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | RIYADH, SAUDI ARABIA | 90183220 | BOL 9388847". Second export line: "2026-01-16 | IGAKU NEEDLES PRIVATE LIMITED | M/S- USM HEALTHCARE MEDICAL DEVICES | STAINLESS STEEEL NEEDLES 22GIV BC ( 0.72 X 67.00MM. ) ... | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | HO CHI MINH C, Vietnam | 90183220 | BOL 8802771". Buyer-side aggregates on same page: "6 M/S- USM HEALTHCARE MEDICAL DEVICES ... VIETNAM", "6 SAUDI MAIS CO.FOR MEDICAL PRODUCTS ... RIYADH-SAUDI ARABIA", "3 M/S-WELLEX LIMITED COMPANY ... EGYPT".
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in the sources reachable in this run. web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck/eximpedia/volza returned HTTP 403, so domestic supply evidence could not be retrieved — recorded as null, not inferred. Note that the same customs page shows the company also importing raw material for its own plant ("2026-02-14 YOUNG WOO CORPORATION ... STAINLESS STEEL CAPILLARY TUBE FOR NEEDLES (FOR CAPTIVE USE) ... 73069090 BOL 7526689" and "2026-02-27 WENZHOU ACMISAWA ... TAPELESS GRINDING MACHINE ... 84609090 BOL 7774815"), which indicates an operating manufacturing facility in Delhi, but that is production evidence, not a domestic sales record.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: two outbound consignments of stainless steel needles under HS 90183220 to Saudi Arabia (BOL 9388847, 2026-02-05) and Vietnam (BOL 8802771, 2026-01-16), both ex Delhi Air Cargo, plus buyer-side aggregates for Egypt (3 shipments). Declared HS 901832 matches the actual recorded HS 90183220 — no correction needed. Source counter vs rows seen: counter 398 total shipments / 7 partners / 9 ports versus 5 rows visible in the free view; the 398 figure is the portal's own counter and was not independently re-counted. Caveat on the declared industry: the company is a needle/cannula manufacturer (medical devices), not 'Продукты питания и FMCG' as claimed — the industry label appears mis-assigned, while the HS code itself is correct. Domestic (India) supply evidence: следов поставок на внутренний рынок не найдено в доступных источниках — GST turnover, GeM/CPPP contracts and annual-report splits are not public in the pages reachable here, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed. Second sources (volza, eximpedia, thecompanycheck) were blocked with HTTP 403 and web_search was down, so the export finding rests on a single portal; the BOL numbers and dates are quoted verbatim from it and were not invented.
